spec_match.rationale: The migration shim snippet is technically correct (patching requestAdapterInfo onto GPUAdapter.prototype returning this.info), but the audit table's library/version claims carry no sources and at least one row is dubious ('wgpu-py-rs (Pyodide)' matches no known library; the three.js r163 and tensorflow.js 4.20 claims are uncited).

interactive.rationale: Pure static table + snippet card — rule 7 explicitly disallows this shape. Nothing probes whether requestAdapterInfo is actually absent and adapter.info present on the visitor's browser, which is exactly the check this feature invites.

blurb_alignment.rationale: Presented as an audit 'useful for picking the version you can ship' — that usefulness depends on the unverified data.

edge_cases.rationale: No live absence probe, no shim try-out, no honest handling for browsers without WebGPU at all.

references.rationale: No sources for any audit row — no release notes, commits, or issue links; a reader cannot verify a single claim from this page.

conformance.rationale: Feature-level suite exists; this page adds no probeable surface to it.

runtime_evidence.rationale: Headless Chromium 141 CDP run: page renders clean (0px overflow both classes, zero console errors); no page behavior exists to verify beyond rendering.

telemetry_health.rationale: No telemetry assert on the page.

design_system.rationale: Status cells put ivory text on accent backgrounds: amber #b87b00 on ivory = 3.48:1 and emerald #0a8f5c = 4.01:1 — both FAIL WCAG AA (4.5:1) at this 0.78rem text size; only the rose cells pass (5.26:1).

accessibility.rationale: Table semantics are fine (aria-label, real headers); the status column encodes meaning in colour+word so it survives, but the failing contrast affects low-vision users.

mobile_desktop_parity.rationale: 47px horizontal page overflow measured at 360×740 DPR3 — the audit table has no scroll wrapper; desktop (1280×2000) is clean.

openQuestions.title: Fix the 47px mobile overflow
openQuestions.detail: Wrap the audit table in an overflow-x:auto container so the page body stops scrolling horizontally at 360px (measured 47px overflow).

openQuestions.title: Source or remove every audit row
openQuestions.detail: Each library/version claim needs a citation (release notes / commit / issue). 'wgpu-py-rs (Pyodide)' matches no known project and looks fabricated — verify or delete. Unverifiable claims presented as a shipping-decision aid are worse than no page.

openQuestions.title: Add the live absence/shim probe
openQuestions.detail: One button: report 'requestAdapterInfo' in GPUAdapter.prototype (when WebGPU exists), then apply the page's own shim and show it working against adapter.info — turning the snippet into the rule-7 interactive demo this page lacks. Handle navigator.gpu-absent honestly.

openQuestions.title: Fix the failing status-cell contrast
openQuestions.detail: Amber/emerald backgrounds with ivory text fail AA (3.48:1 / 4.01:1 measured). Use dark text on light tinted backgrounds, or the accents as text colours on stone.

guidanceConsulted.query: table status cell colour contrast AA
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Text on coloured backgrounds must meet 4.5:1.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: NOT met by the page (measured ratios above) — filed as an open question.

summary: Reviewed headlessly (no chrome-devtools-mcp in this cloud session): a static audit table whose central value — trustworthy version guidance — is unsourced and partly dubious, with measured AA contrast failures in the status cells and no live probe of the removal it documents. Two major and one moderate question filed.
